full_prompt_en: A square contemporary painting shows a dark-haired young person in brightly patterned clothing against a dense field of multicolored leaves and blossoms. The figure fills the center and left of the selected panel from the head to crossed forearms, facing slightly right while looking toward the viewer. Straight black hair is gathered behind the head, with loose strands falling across the forehead and near one ear. The face is built from angular patches of warm yellow, muted violet, peach, and cool blue-gray, making the cheek, nose, and jaw read as faceted planes rather than smoothly blended skin. The mouth is closed and the expression is quiet. A richly colored robe-like garment wraps across the chest and shoulders, with blue, yellow, orange, and dark shapes broken by scattered pale floral marks. One arm folds across the lower part of the frame, where cloth patterns continue into the crowded foreground. Behind the head, overlapping botanical shapes press almost to the edges: broad leaves, small orange and blue flowers, dark blue silhouettes, and irregular pale openings. Little unpainted background remains. The lighting is bright and diffuse, expressed through saturated yellow highlights on the face and garment and cooler shadow patches under the chin and around the hair. Crisp cutout-like shapes coexist with short painterly strokes and thin contour fragments. The overall composition places a still, close figure inside a restless patterned surround, balancing warm luminous color with dark blue accents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形当代绘画呈现一名黑发年轻人，穿着鲜艳花纹衣物，背后是由多彩叶片与花朵组成的密集区域。所选单图中的人物从头部到交叉的前臂，占据中央与左侧，身体稍向右转，目光却朝向观者。直顺黑发在头后束起，几缕散发落在额前和一侧耳旁。脸部由暖黄、低饱和紫、桃色与冷蓝灰的棱角形色块组成，使脸颊、鼻子和下颌呈现切面般的结构，而不是平滑晕开的肤色。嘴唇闭合，神情安静。像长袍的彩色衣物裹过胸前与肩部，蓝、黄、橙及深色形块之间散落浅色花纹。一只手臂横过画面下部，衣料图案延续到拥挤的前景。头部后方，互相遮叠的植物形态几乎挤到边缘：宽叶、小朵橙花与蓝花、深蓝剪影，以及形状不规则的浅色空隙。几乎没有未上色的背景。光线明亮而漫射，以脸部和衣物上的饱和黄色高光、下巴与头发周围较冷的阴影色块表现。清晰的剪纸状形块与短促的绘画笔触、断续细轮廓共存。整体构图把安静的近景人物置于躁动的纹样环境里，以温暖发亮的颜色平衡深蓝色重音。
style_prompt_en: Contemporary painterly color is arranged in interlocking, angular patches that combine crisp graphic edges with short visible brush marks. Faceted warm highlights sit against cooler violet and blue-gray shadow planes, so volume is built by hue changes as much as by value. Saturated yellow, orange, cobalt blue, teal, and small pale accents recur across the entire surface. Layered botanical-like marks and fragmented decorative shapes produce a dense all-over field with only narrow openings of negative space. The brightest warm patches pull attention toward a compact central mass, while darker cool marks keep the surrounding pattern from becoming flat. Lighting remains broad and diffuse, described through local color contrasts instead of cast shadows. The overall effect is vivid, crowded, and mosaic-like, with figural clarity emerging from the patterned color field.
style_prompt_zh: 这种当代绘画色彩组织成彼此嵌合的棱角形色块，兼有清楚的图形边缘与可见的短笔触。切面般的暖色高光贴近较冷的紫色和蓝灰阴影面，使体积既靠色相变化，也靠明度变化建立。饱和黄、橙、钴蓝、青绿与少量浅色重音在整个画面反复出现。层叠的植物状笔痕与破碎装饰形体构成密集、铺满画面的区域，负空间只留下狭窄开口。最亮的暖色块将注意力拉向紧凑的中心色团，较暗的冷色笔痕则避免周围纹样变得平板。光线宽泛而漫射，主要通过局部色彩对比，而非投影来呈现。整体效果鲜明、繁密、如马赛克一般，清晰形体从花纹色域中浮现。
theme_en: A dark-haired young person in patterned clothing before dense multicolored foliage
theme_zh: 一名黑发年轻人身穿花纹衣物，背后是浓密的多彩枝叶
name: Tomokazu Matsuyama
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
